snippet.title: Speeding car crashes into multiple vehicles while driving through roundabout in UK
snippet.description:
Speeding car crashes into multiple vehicles while driving through roundabout in UK.

The creator of the video posted this on social media. "This shocking footage shows the moment a car driven by Darren Marshall, aged 48, of Shepherds Mead, Worthing, crashed at high speed into another vehicle when he exited the M40 and travelled up to the Handycross roundabout. The victims suffered serious injuries as a result of this collision. Marshall has now been given an 8-year driving ban and a suspended prison sentence for dangerous driving. He will also need to take an enhanced test at the end of his disqualification. This incident is a stark reminder of how reckless behaviour behind the wheel can change lives in an instant. Please, drive safely and think of others on the road."

Credit: Thames Valley Police /TMX
